description: Hand-worked economic vectors of the standalone FOP ledger. Every expected number is worked from the plan, not produced by code. tests/helpers/cost_basis_fop_model.py (an exact rational model) must reproduce them; js/cost_basis_fop_core.js and the server timeline in cost_basis_fop_domain.py run the same inputs. A vector lists contracts by alias (catalogue), events in a compact form, optional cycle boundaries, marks and an as-of instant. Expected values: a number, a "p/q" string for an exact fraction, or null for an unknown figure; "reasons" pins the reason of an unknown in the core output (a dotted path; cycles.0.totals.E is the first cycle's E); "ambiguous" names contracts whose order no evidence fixes (the server refuses such a ledger); "model": false marks a vector the rational model does not replay.

eventFields.price: fill price, premium, or baseline price
eventFields.cash: cashAmount of a fee or an adjustment
eventFields.feeSource: the event id a fee belongs to
eventFields.src: primary source record {ns, ref, stated:[quantity, fees]}
